segments.title: Then Building got *a second round*.
segments.cap: From here on, left is the board as round one left it, and right is the board today: every card keeps a dossier, and every project has its chapters.
segments.capzh: 从这里开始，左边是第一轮改完的板子，右边是现在的：每张卡片背后都有一份档案，每个项目都有自己的章节。

beats.bzh: 指向 Fred Agent 的标题。
beats.a: At rest, its dossier's **five index tabs** peek past the card's edge.
beats.azh: 平时，档案的五个索引标签从卡片右边探出来。

beats.b: Click: the card comes to your hand, and a field note opens under it.
beats.bzh: 点一下：卡片拿到面前，下面展开一页笔记。
beats.a: Click: the card comes to your hand, and **the dossier slides out** from under it.
beats.azh: 点一下：卡片拿到面前，档案从它底下滑出来。

beats.b: The note holds one way in.
beats.bzh: 笔记里只有一个入口。
beats.a: Its contents: each chapter's own title and one line, the one figure, status and dates.
beats.azh: 目录上是每一章的标题和一句话，一张图，状态和日期。

beats.bzh: 还有代码仓库。
beats.a: Its tabs run down the fore-edge. The ones that peeked have tucked behind the card.
beats.azh: 索引标签排在书口；刚才探出来的那几个，已经收到卡片后面。

beats.bzh: 点「钉回去」，卡片回到原位。
beats.a: “Pin it back”: the dossier slides up behind the card, the pin goes in, and the tabs **spring back out**.
beats.azh: 点「钉回去」：档案滑回卡片后面，图钉按下去，标签又弹出来。

replay.b: Slowed down: the note unfolds under the card.
replay.bzh: 放慢看：笔记在卡片下面展开。
replay.a: Slowed down: one small overshoot, then it settles. None of it shows before it has slid out from under the card.
replay.azh: 放慢看：冲过头一点，再停稳。它从卡片底下滑出来之前，一点都看不见。

beats.bzh: 把卡片取下来。
beats.a: Take the card down.
beats.azh: 把卡片取下来。

beats.b: The note's one way in: “Enter the field notes”.
beats.bzh: 笔记里唯一的入口：「进入笔记」。
beats.a: Every tab is a way in. This one is **03 principles**.
beats.azh: 每个标签都是一个入口；这个是「03 原则」。

beats.b: Click: a cut to the old sub-site's overview, drawn once React arrives.
beats.bzh: 点一下：切到旧的子站首页，要等 React 到了才画出来。
beats.a: Click: the chapter itself, a static page in the dossier's look. (A cut for now: next, the tabs fly.)
beats.azh: 点一下：直接到这一章，一张静态页面，长得像档案。（现在是硬切；下一步，标签会飞过去。）

beats.b: Its own pill nav swaps Principles in, in place.
beats.bzh: 再用它自己的胶囊导航，原地换成「原则」。
beats.a: A kraft edge, a typed file label, the card clipped on; the current tab is **pulled out and banded**.
beats.azh: 牛皮纸的书口，打字机印的档案标签，卡片夹在角上；当前这一章的标签被抽出来，涂上麦色。

beats.b: The chapter opens with a gradient in its title.
beats.bzh: 这一章打开，标题里是一段渐变。
beats.a: The chapter opens with **Reading's pencil margin** as its contents.
beats.azh: 这一章打开，目录就是「读」页面上的那条铅笔页边。

beats.b: Scroll: the “On this page” list waits in the left column.
beats.bzh: 往下滚：「本页目录」待在左栏。
beats.a: Scroll: the graphite follows your reading, and the pen's loop rings **the current principle**.
beats.azh: 往下滚：铅笔线跟着读到的地方走，笔圈住正在读的那一条。

beats.bzh: 指向一条目录。
beats.a: Point at a number and its **preview slip** comes out.
beats.azh: 指向一个编号，它的预览纸条就出来。

beats.bzh: 接着读到第 06 条。
beats.a: Read on, and the loop moves down to 06.
beats.azh: 接着读，圈就移到 06。

beats.b: Outcomes on top, handles at the bottom. Hover an outcome: its path lights up in dashed red.
beats.bzh: 结果在上，接口在下。指向一个结果：它的路径亮成红色虚线。
beats.a: Handles → protocols → outcomes, the way the argument reads. Hover: the pen **draws the path**.
beats.azh: 接口 → 协议 → 结果，和文字的顺序一样。指上去：笔把这条路径画出来。

beats.bzh: Headless Recovery 包住每一个结果。
beats.a: Headless Recovery wraps every outcome. The lines retract faster than they draw.
beats.azh: Headless Recovery 包住每一个结果；线收回去比画出来快。

beats.b: Click a handle to lock its path; the explainer opens below.
beats.bzh: 点一个接口，锁住路径，下面展开说明。
beats.a: Click to lock: the module is banded in wheat, and its lines **cool into the band's edge**.
beats.azh: 点一下锁住：这个模块涂上麦色，线也冷下来，变成荧光笔边缘的颜色。

beats.bzh: 锁住的路径一直在。
beats.a: Leave the map: the locked path stays.
beats.azh: 指针离开，锁住的路径还在。

beats.bzh: 清除路径。
beats.a: “Clear path”: the pen takes them back.
beats.azh: 点「清除路径」：笔把线收回去。

beats.bzh: 点 Fred Agent。
beats.a: Tap Fred Agent.
beats.azh: 点 Fred Agent。

beats.b: It comes up with its field note.
beats.bzh: 卡片拿起来，带着那页笔记。
beats.a: The dossier slides out. Its tabs stand on its **top edge**, numbers only.
beats.azh: 档案滑出来；标签立在它的上沿，只写编号。

beats.bzh: 滚动笔记，再滚回来。
beats.a: Scroll the hand's layer to read the whole sheet, and back.
beats.azh: 滚动手上这一层，读完整页，再滚回来。

beats.bzh: 钉回去。
beats.a: Pin it back: the tabs peek out again, inside the cork.
beats.azh: 钉回去：标签又探出来，就在软木板里面。

beats.b: Principles: the old pill nav, sticky at the top.
beats.bzh: 「原则」：旧的胶囊导航，贴在顶上。
beats.a: The fore-edge tabs become **a strip**: numbers, and the current one named.
beats.azh: 书口的标签变成一条：只写编号，当前这一章写出名字。

beats.bzh: 往下读。
beats.a: Read down: the counter under the strip counts the principles, **01 / 11, 02 / 11…**
beats.azh: 往下读：标签下面的计数跟着走，01 / 11，02 / 11……

beats.bzh: 「组件」，原地换进来。
beats.a: Tap 04: Components opens, and the strip names it.
beats.azh: 点 04：打开「组件」，标签条写出它的名字。
